nodes.label: CI job: backend-test (pytest, cov>=70, migrations)
nodes.rationale: Ephemeral service Postgres instead of shared Neon: shared instance caused cold-start hangs, stale test DB held by pooled sessions, SSL drops mid test-DB-create. Schema is built WITH migrations (--nomigrations removed) because Rule 1 seeds lookups and platform template samples via data migrations — a DB without them is a different DB. gettext installed because .mo files are build artifacts not in git and a catalog test checks real translations.

nodes.label: CI job: migration-check (clean-DB migrate)
nodes.rationale: backend-test applies migrations but does not check the graph separately: makemigrations --check catches model/migration drift; migrating a clean Postgres surfaces what only shows on a fresh deploy (broken cross-app dependencies, FieldError in seeds, missing migrations).

nodes.label: CI job: api-contract (schema/type drift gate)
nodes.rationale: Regenerates backend/schema.json (spectacular) and frontend/src/api/schema.d.ts (openapi-typescript) and fails on git diff — keeps committed contract honest so frontend types cannot silently rot. Python pinned to 3.12 (the runtime that produced the committed schema).

nodes.label: CI job: frontend-lint (eslint + lint:tsc)
nodes.rationale: tsc --noEmit checked NOTHING: frontend/tsconfig.json is solution-style (files:[] + references) and outside build mode tsc compiles zero files (verified 2026-08-13 — a file with a deliberate type error exited 0). Types were only caught by frontend-build via tsc -b; the step now runs npm run lint:tsc, the same script as local make typecheck.

nodes.label: CI job: docker-build (needs 7 jobs, gha layer cache)
nodes.rationale: GitHub Actions layer cache (type=gha) because psycopg2 compiles from source (INF-09) — without cache every run rebuilds the image from scratch.

nodes.label: CI job: security (pip-audit + npm audit prod hard gate)
nodes.rationale: npm audit hard-gates only production deps (--omit=dev): gate went red 2026-08-08 on js-yaml CVE-2026-59870 in eslint/openapi-typescript dev chains that never reach the bundle and are only fixable by major tool bumps. Runtime libs live in dependencies so the gate still covers everything shipped to users; dev advisories stay visible via a non-blocking step (no separate nightly job — CI minutes are scarce). pip is upgraded first because pip-audit audits pip itself.

nodes.label: CI job: deps-lock (INF-05 lock drift gate)
nodes.rationale: Fails if requirements.txt / requirements-dev.txt drift from the .in sources (someone edited an .in and forgot to recompile). Recompiles with the SAME pinned pip-tools (7.5.3) that authored the lock and asserts no diff.

nodes.label: Concurrency: cancel superseded PR runs
nodes.rationale: A follow-up push cancels the branch's previous run — without this a fix-lint-and-push left the old run burning to completion and one branch consumed two-three full CI runs. Not cancelled on main, where the run confirms what is already merged.

nodes.label: paths-ignore for Docs/docs/*.md
nodes.rationale: Docs-only edits touch neither code nor contract — a full run on them is pure waste of minutes (a docs-only PR used to run all 11 jobs incl. backend-test and docker-build). Both 'Docs/' and 'docs/' listed because macOS treats them as one directory, Linux as two.
